desc: The most office-symbol-specific document in the domain. Published 30 January 2026, 'The Hidden Wing' deliberately departs from the testimony-review format and instead attempts to map the current, modern-day administrative and organizational structure of alleged Air Force clandestine UFO programs, working through the Department of the Air Force, Headquarters Air Force, MAJCOMs, Wings and Major Range and Test Facility Bases. Its executive summary names specific compartments: SAF/AQ (Acquisition) under the Secretariat, SAF/AA (Administrative Assistant to the Secretary of the Air Force), AF/TE (Test and Evaluation) under Compliance on the Air Staff, and AFOSI. Within SAF/AQ it names the directorates SAF/AQX (Acquisition Integration), SAF/AQL (Special Programs) and SAF/AQR (Science, Technology and Engineering). It alleges that SAF/AAH (Sensitive Activities) and SAF/AZ (Security, Special Programs Oversight and Information Protection), and their directors Russell Wyler and William Maclure, likely constitute the Air Force SES-2 gatekeeper Christopher Mellon has publicly referred to. It identifies AFOSI/PJ, the Office of Special Projects, and its former director Terry Phillips - now Northrop Grumman Vice President for Security - as an operative node. The value of this document is that every office symbol in it is real and checkable against Air Force organisational records; the allegation is about function, not existence.
